instruction: Find all men's extra-large short-sleeve shirts with a discount of 50% or more.

metadata.explanation: Variation 9: Changed size from L to XL, keeps short-sleeve and 50% discount. Maintains same complexity and interaction pattern as original task.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator checks all 5 requirements from instruction: men's clothing, shirts, XL size, short-sleeve, and 50% discount
Getter function correctly parses Macy's URL structure to extract search parameters
Metric function appropriately compares extracted values against expected values
Price discount range checking logic has a flaw (chrome.py:2550-2554): rejects valid results when multiple discount ranges are present (e.g., both 50% and 30% ranges)
No postconfig specified to ensure browser state is correct, though evaluator should work if search completes successfully
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Fix price discount logic at chrome.py:2550-2554 - should check if '50_PERCENT_ off & more' is in the list OR is the only/highest discount level, not reject when lower discount tiers are also present
Consider adding a postconfig step to ensure Chrome is in focus and the search results page is fully loaded before evaluation
Add more robust handling for cases where the URL might have different parameter orderings or encoding variations
